exact: regulation of branching involved in salivary gland morphogenesis by extracellular matrix-epithelial cell signalling

definition: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of salivary gland branching as a result of the transfer of information from the extracellular matrix to the epithelium of the salivary gland.
label: regulation of branching involved in salivary gland morphogenesis by extracellular matrix-epithelial cell signaling
